summary: The rem1 change updates two stale test pins and nothing else. Commits 83ff86879 and 48a851a98 touch only measure/tracks/storytime_look_20261107/plan.md, and commit a04837606 touches only the two test files apps/storytime/__tests__/login-media-sign.test.ts and apps/storytime/__tests__/look-adversarial-p2b.test.ts. No route, API, component, message, or user-flow file changed in the rem1 commits. Both new pin values reproduce against the shipped product at HEAD: the signed media map of w01 gives 70 distinct files with 32 file-only paths and 38 unsigned under the old pin, and the app sources hold exactly two files with tabIndex, so the exact-list pin still guards every other file. The earlier Review C result review-c-p3-b9ba532bf.json still holds at this HEAD with no contract surface changed.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] carried from review-c-p3-b9ba532bf.json, still holds at HEAD 48a851a98: apps/storytime/content/l2/w02.json to w07.json keep meta.status draft, and the review switch STORYTIME_REVIEW_DRAFT_WEEKS=1 of tasks 3.5 and 3.6 (commit f438d09d7) opens draft weeks in the local review environment only. The rem1 commits changed no week file and no lib/content.ts, so the finding status is unchanged. | not a CONTEST item: carried for continuity

F2 [Minor] carried from review-c-p3-b9ba532bf.json, still holds at HEAD 48a851a98: apps/storytime/app/[locale]/st/[level]/[week]/reader.tsx line 370 still builds the tap key with word.word.toLowerCase() only, so a curly apostrophe or outer punctuation in a later week would make a visible tap target whose key lookup misses. The rem1 commits changed no reader file. | not a CONTEST item: carried for continuity

evidence: git rev-parse HEAD returns 48a851a989681aa7dd2018865a9b52b70f0ac7c2, so the audited HEAD is current at the audit start.

git show --stat 83ff86879 lists one file, measure/tracks/storytime_look_20261107/plan.md, one insertion. git show --stat a04837606 lists exactly apps/storytime/__tests__/login-media-sign.test.ts (12 changed lines) and apps/storytime/__tests__/look-adversarial-p2b.test.ts (11 changed lines). git show --stat 48a851a98 lists one file, plan.md, one changed line. No route, API, component, message, or user-flow file appears in any rem1 commit.

F781 reproduced with python3 against apps/storytime/content/l2/w01.json through the walker semantics of apps/storytime/scripts/receive-weeks.ts line 192 (mediaPathsOf, MEDIA_EXTENSION at line 181, approval subtree excluded per login-media-sign.test.ts lines 78 to 82): expected=70, file_only=32, unsigned=38, entries=108. The three pin values at login-media-sign.test.ts lines 86, 96, and 99 (70, 32, 38) match the reproduced counts exactly, and no check became a range.

F782 reproduced with grep over the sourceFiles() roots of look-adversarial-p2b.test.ts line 210 (apps/storytime/app, packages/read-along/components, packages/read-along/lib): the only tabIndex hits are apps/storytime/app/[locale]/teacher/[level]/[week]/[day]/lesson-flow.tsx line 1008 (one occurrence) and packages/read-along/components/read-along/read-along-passage.tsx lines 111 and 170 (two occurrences). tabIndexSites at look-adversarial-p2b.test.ts line 283 counts occurrences per file, so the exact pin [lesson-flow.tsx:1, read-along-passage.tsx:2] matches the sources. The list stays toEqual, so every other file still fails the check.

The one allowed path of F782 is the teacher end region at lesson-flow.tsx lines 1005 to 1015: role="region", tabIndex={-1}, ref={endRef}, aria-label="The end of the lesson". tabIndex={-1} is a focus target and takes no place in the tab order, so the M4 guard against a new tab stop keeps its meaning, and the pin message and the plan evidence name this reason.

The earlier Review C result review-c-p3-b9ba532bf.json had status pass with three nonblocking findings F1, F2, F3 and no blocking finding. All three still hold at this HEAD: w02.json line 47 keeps meta.status draft, reader.tsx line 370 keeps toLowerCase, and no rem1 commit touches decodable.tsx or any week file.

The role_base_sha 2399d3075888275c937cd98dc78dab5a9e664fd0 named in the plan evidence of task 3.7 appears in git log between the phase base 2655632aa and the audited HEAD, so the provenance chain is intact.

The 240 commits between the phase base and the audited HEAD include many other tracks (storytime_app_rebuild_20261025 Phase 4 and 5, primary_class_session_lifetime_20261111, sales_training_2027_20261015). Per the brief these are out of scope; the phase diff of this review is the three rem1 commits only.

ratings.evidence: Both pin values reproduce against the shipped product: the python3 walk gives 70/32/38 and the grep gives exactly the two pinned tabIndex files.
The pins are exact values, not ranges, and the F7g control keeps 32 and 38; I verified values by reproduction, not by rerunning the suite, so the Green run log stays the plan evidence.
git show --stat for the three rem1 commits lists only plan.md and the two named test files.
